description: Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) catalogue lookup, version 2026-08-25 (dev.ucp.shopping.catalog.lookup). arguments: meta {'ucp-agent': {profile}} (required) and catalog {ids: product ids (GTIN) or variant ids (<market>:<gtin14>), up to 50; context; filters}. Found rows come back as products with their claim_status; an id outside the priced subset answers an info not_found message.
name: lookup_catalog
title: Lookup Catalog
